svg.title: Horse
svg.desc: Standing bay horse with long distal limbs, single hooves, black mane and tail, and a deep thorax. Biological basis: Horses support veterinary and comparative work in musculoskeletal injury, exercise physiology, cardiopulmonary function, immunology, and reproduction.
